# Ninja Reflection

> > An Asian drama enthusiast's blog covering Chinese, Korean, and Japanese dramas with episode recaps, first impressions, and novel translations including The Rise of Phoenixes.

Ninja Reflection specializes in detailed episode recaps, drama reviews, and weekly roundups of Asian television series. The site also features original novel translations, particularly of Chinese historical fiction like The Rise of Phoenixes, serving fans of romance and historical dramas across East Asian entertainment.

## Key Topics

- The Rise of Phoenixes
- Chinese drama
- Korean drama
- Japanese drama
- Episode recaps
- Drama reviews
- Novel translation
- Romance drama
- Historical fiction
- Weekly roundup
- First impressions
- Asian drama
- Zhi Wei
- Qing Chen
- Yuan Ling

## The Rise of Phoenixes Novel Translations

- [The Rise of Phoenixes Novel Translation #78](https://ninja-reflection.com/2020/05/04/the-rise-of-phoenixes-novel-translation-78): Chapter 78 translation of The Rise of Phoenixes novel with Zhi Wei
- [The Rise of Phoenixes Novel Translation #64](https://ninja-reflection.com/2020/01/27/the-rise-of-phoenixes-novel-translation-64): Chapter 64 translation of The Rise of Phoenixes historical fiction novel
- [The Rise of Phoenixes Novel Translation #84](https://ninja-reflection.com/2020/06/15/the-rise-of-phoenixes-novel-translation-84): Chapter 84 translation featuring Gu Nan Yi, Zhi Wei, and Ning Yi
